questionText: In the context of owner and weak entity sets in the ER (Entity-Relationship) data model, which one of the following statements is TRUE?
options: The weak entity set MUST have total participation in the identifying relationship
The owner entity set MUST have total participation in the identifying relationship
Both weak and owner entity sets MUST have total participation in the identifying relationship
Neither weak entity set nor owner entity set MUST have total participation in the identifying relationship
explanation:
In an Entity-Relationship (ER) model:

1. A weak entity set does not possess a primary key on its own and depends on a strong (owner) entity set for its existence.
2. Since every weak entity instance must be linked to an owner entity instance to be uniquely identified, the weak entity set MUST have total participation in the identifying relationship.
3. Conversely, an owner entity set can exist independently without having associated weak entities, so its participation in the identifying relationship can be partial.

Therefore, Option (A) is correct.
